from transformers import AutoTokenizer
import json

tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('Qwen/Qwen3-4B', trust_remote_code=True)

SYSTEM_PROMPT = 'You are a code verifier. Given a code patch (git diff) and a test name, predict whether the test will pass or fail when run against the patched code.'
USER_TEMPLATE = '## Patch (git diff)\n{code}\n\n## Test\n{test}\n\nWill this test pass or fail?'

def get_prompt_length(d):
    user_msg = USER_TEMPLATE.format(code=d['code'], test=d['test'])
    msgs = [{'role': 'system', 'content': SYSTEM_PROMPT}, {'role': 'user', 'content': user_msg}]
    try:
        ids = tokenizer.apply_chat_template(msgs, tokenize=True, add_generation_prompt=True, enable_thinking=False)
    except TypeError:
        ids = tokenizer.apply_chat_template(msgs, tokenize=True, add_generation_prompt=True)
    if hasattr(ids, 'input_ids'):
        ids = ids.input_ids
    return len(ids)

for split in ['val', 'test']:
    with open(f'data/swebench_full/swebench_{split}.jsonl') as f:
        data = [json.loads(line) for line in f]
    
    lengths = [get_prompt_length(d) for d in data]
    lengths.sort()
    n = len(lengths)
    over_2048 = sum(1 for x in lengths if x > 2048)
    over_4096 = sum(1 for x in lengths if x > 4096)
    
    print(f'=== {split} (n={n}) ===')
    print(f'  Mean: {sum(lengths)/n:.0f}, Median: {lengths[n//2]}, Max: {max(lengths)}')
    print(f'  >2048: {over_2048} ({over_2048/n*100:.1f}%)')
    print(f'  >4096: {over_4096} ({over_4096/n*100:.1f}%)')
    for pct in [50, 75, 90, 95, 99]:
        idx = min(int(n * pct / 100), n-1)
        print(f'  P{pct}: {lengths[idx]}')
